text:
maria: FYI PR #33210 is hitting a weird CI-only snapshot flicker on stage-3. passes locally every time. build shows a tiny ordering diff in the snapshot, not actual content change. link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/33210 :eyes:
sam: saw that earlier, thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing snippet?
ci-bot: Build #4567 — stage-3 — failed (non-zero exit). Log: `SnapshotMismatch: expected order A,B,C got B,A,C` — artifacts: https://artifacts/redwood/33210/4567
maria: pasted log: ```
AssertionError: Snap mismatch at line 12
- expected: ["init", "load", "apply"]
- actual:   ["load", "init", "apply"]
```
jon: hmm order flip suggests a race in test harness. did we recently parallelize something in the fixture setup?
maria: not in this PR. it's a lib change that touches KV warmup ordering, though. can't repro locally with `./scripts/test single --seed 42`
sam: two options: 1) targeted rerun on the failing shard to see if it's flakey, 2) add a tiny deterministic barrier in the test or 3) accept snapshot update if you're confident it's harmless.
ash (ci-bot): Requested targeted rerun for build #4567 — queued.
ci-bot: Targeted rerun completed — PASS on rerun (build #4567.2).
maria: rerun passed once, but original failed — leaning flake. still worried about nondet behavior in prod.
jon: can you try `TEST_PARALLEL=1 ./scripts/test single --repeat 50 --seed random` in CI-like env? sometimes local dev hides scheduling differences.
maria: will run a 50-repeat job on a dedicated runner tonight and post results. also bisecting the warmup patch locally.
ash (ci-bot): Nightly job scheduled: `replicate/ci-flakiness-run-1739991234` — will post summary.
ash (ci-bot): Nightly job finished: 50 runs -> 1 failure (same ordering flip) — link: https://artifacts/redwood/flaky/1739991234
sam: 1/50 is flaky territory. if we can make a minimal guard in the test (e.g., sort entries or assert set membership rather than strict order) that reduces false positives.
maria: agree. test intent is to validate contents not strict ordering. i'll open a tiny follow-up that relaxes the snapshot equality to compare unordered lists and include a comment explaining why.
ash (ci-bot): PR #33211 created by maria: "relax snapshot ordering for kv warmup test" — https://github.com/redwood/pr/33211
aj: (reaction) :thumbsup:
ash (ci-bot): PR #33210 status: waiting on 1 more approval before merge.
ash (ci-bot): PR #33211 status: ready for review.
ash (ci-bot): Note: If we update the snapshot for #33210 instead, we risk masking the race. Recommend patch in #33211 instead.
ash (ci-bot): @ashley please review both small PRs when you have a min.
ash (ci-bot): current approvals: maria (author). required: 2
ash (ci-bot): merge hold will expire in 24h if no action.
ash (ci-bot): To run a targeted rerun yourself: `bk retry build 4567 --shard stage-3`
ash (ci-bot): To approve: add a reviewer and `/approve` in PR comment.
ash (ci-bot): To update snapshot: edit `tests/snapshots/kv_warmup.snap` and push.
ash (ci-bot): To add a temporary guard: `assert set(actual)==set(expected)` in test body
ash (ci-bot): To revert later, add a TODO and a tracking ticket (recommended).
ash (ci-bot): For context, team lead requested triage before snapshot updates on infra-affecting tests.
ash (ci-bot): ETA reminders will post in 12h if no activity.
ash (ci-bot): If you'd like me to force a rerun every hour for 6 attempts, react with :repeat:
ash (ci-bot): If you need a dedicated runner with same config as CI, tag `infra-runner`
ash (ci-bot): Done. tagging infra-runner for maria's 50x debug run.
maria: thanks all — i'll push the relax-ordering patch in #33211 and request review. will link results of the 50x run here once done.
ash (ci-bot): thread closed for now, will reopen on new activity.
